about: Tracker declaration of the fixed online shop, read by scripts/check-privacy.mjs. Only the entries of "exempt" may be present before consent. The third parties listed with "exempt": false run only after consent through the reference consent loader.

exempt.name: eu-consent
exempt.justification: Set by the reference consent banner. Stores only the visitor's choice per purpose, its date and the banner version; no identifier.

exempt.name: basket
exempt.justification: Written only when the visitor uses "Add to basket"; holds product ids, names, prices and quantities, nothing else.
